versions.changelog: 1.0.2 security remediation of the auto-pay finding, done properly: the client no longer wraps an auto-paying fetch. It gates the received challenge, presigns a Payment built ONLY from that gated object, audits the exact pre-sign bytes (Payment type, signer Account, Destination==payTo, Amount==gated drops, SourceTag, invoice Memo present, LastLedgerSequence set) before calling sign(), pins a bounded horizon (MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=300) and expected sourceTag, verifies the seller receipt tx hash equals its own signature hash, and reserves spend in a persisted daily ledger. Adds offline structural proof (--selftest, 16 gates) plus a harness proving refusals never write spend; docs updated to warn against cap-on-probe/pay-different-invoice patterns.

1.0.1: security remediation for the auto-pay finding — bundled fail-closed client scripts/guarded-buy.cjs becomes the primary example (pre-sign challenge inspection, MAX_DROPS cap, persisted daily budget ledger, pinned host/payTo/network/scheme, refuses malformed challenges); added skill-card.md with pricing + limits + verification pointers.
v1.0.0: first public release — pay-per-request x402 v2 + flat plans for live XRPL fee/queue/liveness telemetry and proxied ledger/account_info reads.
